# data-providers commands

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `get` | Get details for a specific data provider |
| `list` | List registered data providers in the environment |
| `register` | Register a new data provider with plugin operation bindings |
| `unregister` | Unregister a data provider from Dataverse |
| `update` | Update plugin bindings on an existing data provider |
